text:
The supplied quality records include measure results for MED-REC, CLABSI-01, and HAPI-02.

For MED-REC, “Medication reconciliation completion at discharge,” the reported period is 2026-Q1. The unit is percent. The numerator is 66, the denominator is 265, exclusions are 2, and the reported rate is 25.1 percent. The event_dates field lists 2026-02-09, 2026-05-02, 2026-06-13, 2026-08-15, and 2026-09-01.

For CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” the reported period is 2026-Q2. The unit is per 1,000 line-days. The numerator is 107, the denominator is 1242, exclusions are 66, and the reported rate is 90.99 per 1,000 line-days. The event_dates field lists 2026-01-11, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-22, 2026-10-02, and 2026-11-03.

For HAPI-02, “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” the reported period is 2026-Q1. The unit is percent. The numerator is 225, the denominator is 1274, exclusions are 32, and the reported rate is 18.12 percent. The event_dates field lists 2026-01-19, 2026-05-17, 2026-05-19, 2026-06-27, and 2026-12-07.

Across the supplied records, the measure units include percent for MED-REC and HAPI-02, and per 1,000 line-days for CLABSI-01. The records provide measure identifiers, measure names, reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, units, and event_dates for each measure. No additional benchmarks, targets, stratifications, or reference-based contextual findings are included in the supplied source records.

references.citation: M. Okafor et al., "Nurse staffing analytics: a multicenter study," Annals of Simulated Quality, vol. 38, pp. 138-789, 2021, doi: 10.9999/synth.404576.
